title: The activation mechanisms of permonosulfate and pollutant degradation pathways by generated reactive species
content:
Environ. Sci.: Nano, 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5EN00675A, Tutorial Review
Lingyan Pang, Yihua Liu, Zhirong Meng, Anjing Du, Jianjun Gu, Hui Liu
This paper summarizes the main activation modes of peroxomonosulfate, the radical and non-radical degradation pathways, and the typical applications in organic pollutant removal through various degradation pathways.
